title: RunConfig
description: Owned runtime invocation configuration injected by the data plane per run.

user_id.description: Authenticated user identifier used for runtime ownership and shielding.

thread_id.description: Runtime thread identifier used to bind checkpoint state.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier used for tool execution context.

invocation_id.description: Optional invocation identifier for trace and retry correlation.

project_id.description: Optional project identifier used for policy and spend attribution.

organization_id.description: Organization the run belongs to; stamped from the authenticated caller.

agent_id.description: Agent scope this run executes as; required to reach agent-bound memory.

swarm_id.description: Swarm scope this run executes as; required to reach swarm-bound memory.

client_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone reported by the invoking SDK client.

sdk_deployment_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone configured for the SDK deployment.

model_directive.description: Optional runtime model directive selected at invocation time.

routing_preference.description: Ask auto routing to lean faster, cheaper, or stronger than the request content alone would pick. Absent means no preference. Only auto routing reads it; every other directive already names its own tier. One value rather than separate flags, because these are mutually exclusive and a caller cannot ask for two at once.

system_model_choices.description: Optional explicit model choices for framework-owned system tools. Absent preserves each tool's internal default profile.

thinking.description: Optional model choice for the think system tool.

compose_argument.description: Optional model choice for compose_argument synthesis.

repl.description: Optional model choice for REPL code generation and repair.

planning.description: Optional explicit model choice for framework-owned planning.

job_depth.description: Execution-tree depth for nested assignment replay and ordering.

job_index.description: Execution-tree sibling index for causal ordering within a parent.

parent_assignment_uuid.description: Optional parent assignment UUID for nested job lineage.

child_run_kind.description: Absent means an ordinary root invocation. What KIND of child run this is, not merely that it is one: a swarm member and a decomposed tool job both report job_depth 1.

plan_node_id.description: Stable identifier of the plan node this run executes; survives retries and re-planning, which a sibling ordinal does not.

decomposition_depth.description: How many JOB boundaries deep this run is, counted separately from job_depth so swarm hops do not spend the decomposition budget.

recursion_limit.description: Runtime cycle guard; defaults to the v1 parity value of 100.

durability.description: Checkpoint persistence mode; exit persists at run exit or interrupt.

origin.description: Optional self-reported invoking client, display/filter only, never consulted for authorization. Conventional starting set: studio, alpha, portal, sdk. Not an enforced enum - unrecognized values from newer clients are accepted and read back as-is; absent on historical rows.
